versions.assembler: GNU assembler version 2.6 (mips-kmc-elf), using BFD version 2.6

note: Authenticated native Windows/MSYS2 GNU Binutils 2.6 bundle. Tracked opt-in BFD patches preserve the accepted one-section-per-PT_LOAD contract, recover exact section LMAs for overlapping overlays, extract binary output in LMA order, and pair KMC symbolic HI16/LO16 relocations across intervening relocations. GNU ld 2.6 predates PHDRS syntax and its stock binary backend uses VMA. The ignored localRoot is populated by the pinned build recipe; production fails closed on every executable and runner hash.
